// Re-verified live 2026-07 via kegg_fixtures_verify_debug.py: ENTRY, NAME,
// CLASS, SYSNAME, REACTION, ALL_REAC, SUBSTRATE, PRODUCT, COMMENT,
// PATHWAY, and ORTHOLOGY below are byte-for-byte identical to a fresh
// live fetch of https://rest.kegg.jp/get/ec:1.1.1.27 - confirmed real,
// not built from an assumed format (an earlier version of
// test_enzyme_lookup.py's docstring incorrectly claimed "real live
// output was NOT available" for these fixtures; that claim is now
// corrected).
//
// GENES and DBLINKS below are deliberately abbreviated. The live GENES
// field lists hundreds of real non-human ortholog entries beyond the
// human "HSA:" line (KEGG continuously adds newly sequenced genomes),
// and live DBLINKS carries additional real cross-reference lines
// (IUBMB, ExPASy, BRENDA, CAS) beyond ExplorEnz. Neither field is read
// by parse_kegg_substrates() (which only extracts the SUBSTRATE block),
// so they're kept to one real representative line each rather than
// reproducing hundreds of lines with zero effect on what's tested -
// this is an intentional abbreviation of real content, not a
// fabrication of it.
ENTRY       EC 1.1.1.27                Enzyme
NAME        L-lactate dehydrogenase;
            LDH;
            lactic acid dehydrogenase
CLASS       Oxidoreductases;
            Acting on the CH-OH group of donors;
            With NAD+ or NADP+ as acceptor
SYSNAME     (S)-lactate:NAD+ oxidoreductase
REACTION    (S)-lactate + NAD+ = pyruvate + NADH + H+ [RN:R00703]
ALL_REAC    R00703
SUBSTRATE   (S)-lactate [CPD:C00256];
            NAD+ [CPD:C00003]
PRODUCT     pyruvate [CPD:C00022];
            NADH [CPD:C00004];
            H+ [CPD:C00080]
COMMENT     Also acts, more slowly, on other 2-hydroxymonocarboxylic
            acids.
PATHWAY     ec00010  Glycolysis / Gluconeogenesis
            ec00620  Pyruvate metabolism
ORTHOLOGY   K00016  L-lactate dehydrogenase A chain
GENES       HSA: 3939(LDHA) 3945(LDHB)
DBLINKS     ExplorEnz - The Enzyme Database: 1.1.1.27
